# key: # Lexicon overrides applied by tools/build_library/pack.py (B4b; docs/LIBRARY_CHANGES.md). Written by the project.
# key   = greek_key of the lemma headword (final sigma σ or ς; the packer folds it). The row applies to every lemma with that key that has
# tags  = the cell, as Kaikki-style tags: tense, voice, mood, person, number (+ "Attic" when the lemma's table is
#         Attic-marked, so the feature word is the table's own). "@from <tense> ..." builds the compound's cells of
#         these tenses from the simplex (only when the compound has no table of that tense).
# form  = the Attic form for the cell (the display is taken from the lemma's table when it lists the same form with
# old   = "dialect": the other forms' analyses for this cell get ANAL bit4 (non-Attic); "keep": they stay as they
#         are; "alt [forms]": the replaced form (or the listed forms) become an alternative for this cell (ANAL bit3);
#         "drop [forms]": their analyses of this cell are removed (a table error). (alt / drop: B4c)
# Lemma rows (B4c): tags "@gender", form = gender words: sets the lemma gender; tags "@alt-table", form = a table
#         marker of the lemma (as in table_forms.tsv, e.g. "Attic declension-3"): that table's cells rank after the
#         other tables' and its analyses that no other table gives get ANAL bit3 (the headword itself never does).
# πίνω aorist imperative: no row. The cell πίε stays: LSJ s.v. πίνω gives "imper. πίε Od. 9.347, Men. 151 ...; also
# πῖθι Cratin., Ar. V. 1489, Antiph. ..." (both Attic; πίε is LSJ's first form). The engine's attested override
